Several days (5 bosses in 5 regions of the map; each boss has a 20 h cooldown)

{npc:S'Zallar M'Andar}, in Ab'Dendriel, senses that the spirits of the ancestral dragons are not at rest. With the {item:Jade Dragon Head} talisman you visit the dragon graveyard in Draconia and go through four lairs (Greenshore, Pits of Inferno, Okolnir and Kha'zeel), defeat their guardians and touch the relics of the four ancestors. At the end you face the necromancer {creature:Bone Overlord} in the Forgotten Crypt, beneath Draconia, and receive a random {item:Crypt Rune}, a talisman that recharges every 14 days and access to the new hunting crypts.
A mysterious necromancer emerges and puts Tibia's dragons in danger.
The bosses are done **in order**: Adventurer Group → Eldritch Dragon Lord → Ice Horror → The Gravedigger → Bone Overlord. Each one requires the previous one defeated **and** its relic touched.
{wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} completed, so that {npc:Buddel} takes you to Okolnir (Ice Horror boss).
{item:Key 3012} to enter the {wiki:Hellgate} on your first visit to Draconia ({npc:Elathriel} sells it for 5000 gp).

To reach the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair}: {item:Blood}, {item:Oil} and {item:The Holy Tible}, as for the entrance of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}. To get the Holy Tible you need {spell:Levitate} or 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels}.
Team: the spoiler describes all the fights for several players (*party*); go as a group.
received at the start; you must have it with you when touching each relic, and it is used to report
Loose Stone Pile in the Plains of Havoc graveyard
open the hole and cool the lava on the way to the Pits of Inferno dragon lair
to pass the Shrine of Wonders

Ice Horror (against Fear) and Bone Overlord
mandatory for The Gravedigger; watch out for Buddel, who keeps it if you carry it in your backpack (see section 5)
or the Levitate spell: to leave Draconia via the Hellgate (and 3 for the Holy Tible)

Protection gear for each boss: energy, earth, fire, holy, ice and physical for the Adventurer Group; fire for the Eldritch Dragon Lord; ice and death for the Ice Horror; death and energy for the Gravedigger; death and energy (phase 1) and life drain and death (phase 2) for the Bone Overlord.
a random one: Ancient, Deathly, Fiery, Icy or Necromantic
every 14 days gives 1 Ancestral Charge and 1 Favour of the Ancients
Access to the {wiki:Forgotten Crypt|Forgotten Crypt}, the {wiki:Forsaken Crypt|Forsaken Crypt} and the {wiki:Unhallowed Crypt|Unhallowed Crypt}
After the quest, the bosses can drop Crypt Runes, which can be exchanged for Crypt weapons

Loot and experience from the five bosses: {creature:Fatal Bug}, {creature:Eldritch Dragon Lord} and {creature:The Gravedigger} give 750,000 experience each, the {creature:Ice Horror} 259,000 and the {creature:Bonelords's Phylactery} 1,000,000
In the final mission, after the four bosses: {npc:S'Zallar M'Andar} takes you by canoe ({key:passage}).
Free entry; it is the way to the Bone Overlord. The Crypt Constructs drop {item:Fetid Heart|Fetid Hearts}.
With the quest done, by spending {wiki:Ancestral Charge|Ancestral Charges}.
Each entry costs 1 Ancestral Charge. Area designed for solo hunting.
With the quest done, by spending {wiki:Favour of the Ancients|Favour of the Ancients}.
Each entry costs 1 Favour of the Ancients.
Charged talisman: Ancestral Charge and Favour of the Ancients every 14 days
By using the {item:Jade Dragon Head} after finishing the quest.
Exchanging Crypt Runes for Crypt weapons
After finishing the quest: the five bosses can now drop Crypt Runes.
One rune of each type handed to the {npc:Dragon Ancestor Spirit} ({key:trade}) gives a random Crypt weapon.
**Always** carry the {item:Jade Dragon Head}: you must have it with you when you use each relic, and using it is how you report to S'Zallar and find out the next lair.
Each boss has a **20-hour** cooldown. If you fail, you can only try again the next day (or use that boss's reset item, see section 8).
After each boss there is a **green teleport** that leads to the relic. That teleport **cannot be used to escape**: it only works after the boss dies, even if you have done the fight before.
If you lose the talisman, say {key:talisman} to {npc:S'Zallar M'Andar}: he makes another one, but warns that you have to pay him back what he spent (the wiki does not say how much).
The wiki does not document the exit from the relic rooms. A {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it does not work in no-logout zones or with a logout block).
The quest starts and ends with S'Zallar M'Andar, in Ab'Dendriel. He gives you the talisman you will use at every stage.

Take a boat to **Ab'Dendriel** from Carlin, Edron, Thais or Venore (say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} to the captain). You arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}'s harbour, on the **east** side of the city.

Go to {npc:S'Zallar M'Andar}, **north/north-east** of the city centre. Say {key:hi}, {key:unrest} and {key:yes}. He tells you that the spirits of the dragon cemetery are restless and that the cause lies in a place where scaled beings cannot enter. He gives you a talisman, the {item:Jade Dragon Head}, so that you can talk to him from afar.
Keep the talisman safe. If you lose it, say {key:talisman} to S'Zallar: he makes another one, but you have to pay him back what he spent.
2. Visit Draconia and the Dragon Cemetery

On this first visit you go to {wiki:Draconia|Draconia} through the {wiki:Hellgate|Hellgate}, beneath Ab'Dendriel (S'Zallar's canoe only appears in the final mission). Draconia is an island north-east of Ab'Dendriel with no boat: read the exit steps before you go.

If you do not have {item:Key 3012} yet, buy it from {npc:Elathriel}, the prison guard of Shadow Caves Street, **2 floors below** the surface (it is on the way to the Hellgate). Say {key:hi}, {key:key} and {key:yes}: it costs **5000 gp**.
Go down to the Shadow Caves

In Ab'Dendriel go down **1 floor**, to the shops level: you are in the {wiki:Shadow Caves|Shadow Caves}, underground **north-west** of the depot. Go down **2 more floors** (the first one next to the little houses) and follow the cave **south** and then **east** to a normally closed door: this is the entrance to the Hellgate, 3 floors below the surface.
Path to the Hellgate (3): the door is to the east
Open the door with {item:Key 3012} and step into the **north** teleport to enter the Hellgate.
Cross the Hellgate to Redbone Castle

Follow the route in the image to {wiki:Redbone Castle|Redbone Castle}, an island in a lava lake at the end of the Hellgate. The map ends there, but from the castle there is only **one path**, which takes you up to the surface of Draconia.
Redbone Castle (end of the route map)
Route through the Hellgate to Draconia

Along the way there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and sometimes lured {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}. If you run into anything else, you have taken a wrong turn.
Once on the surface of Draconia, use the {item:Jade Dragon Head}. You get: *"You arrived. Great! Now investigate the Dragon Cemetery for a hint about what is going on there."*
Go down to the Dragon Cemetery
Go **north** and go down through the hole at this spot **twice** to reach the dragon cemetery.
Hole to the Dragon Cemetery (go down 2 times)
Talk to the Dragon Ancestor Spirit

Say {key:hi} and {key:spirit}. The spirit explains that the souls of four ancestral dragons (**Myzareth**, **Zharvorin**, **Elyrax** and **Scarith**) are bound by a necromancer hidden in the depths. Each dragon tied its essence to a lair and a relic: only through them can the spirits be freed.

Climb back up through the cemetery holes (bring a {item:Rope}). If you brought a {item:White Mushroom}, go up to the top of the mountain in the **north** of the island and say {key:hi} to {npc:An Old Dragonlord}: with the mushroom in your backpack, he immediately trades it for a {item:Dragonfetish}. Sacrifice the fetish in the exit teleport room, in the {creature:Dragon|Dragons} lair beneath the **south-east** of the island, and you are teleported to **Ab'Dendriel**.

There is a Dragon in the teleport room. Do not lose the Dragonfetish before using it: you will not get another one. The Draconia page says you only get one per character (if you talk to him again, he sends you away); the item page says you only get a new one after using the previous one. For the final trip (section 7), also be prepared to leave on foot.
Leave Draconia (option 2: on foot through the Hellgate)

Go back down to Redbone Castle and follow the normal Hellgate exit route ({wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}), which passes very close to the Draconia entrance. You need a {item:Rope} and **6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} or the {spell:Levitate} spell**: in the creature-free stretch to the **north-west**, go up 2 floors with parcels/Levitate and then the ladder; go **south-west** and climb up through the hole; if the bridge on the floor above is closed, pull the lever; from there there is only one way up (lots of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}). You come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel.
Hellgate exit: map 9 (up to the surface)
A third way out is to finish the {wiki:Draconia Quest} and use the portal at the top of the pyramid, which drops you in Ab'Dendriel.
Back in Ab'Dendriel, talk to {npc:S'Zallar M'Andar}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}.
The first guardian is a group of five adventurers, one of each vocation, in a lair beneath Greenshore, north of Thais. Cooldown: 20 hours.

Go to **Thais** (from Ab'Dendriel, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}). Leave the city and walk **north** to {wiki:Greenshore|Greenshore}, a small peninsula with a pass through the mountain. The lair entrance is at this spot and the boss room is **2 floors below**.
The {creature:Adventurer Group} mixes almost every damage type: the wiki recommends protection against **energy, earth, fire, holy, ice and physical**. All five attack at the same time:
You face all five **at the same time**. When one of them drops to **red** health, it turns into its avatar: it gains more damage protection and starts dealing **critical hits**.
There are 3 {creature:Bright Crystal|Bright Crystals} in the room. If you damage them, they explode with a mana drain attack and apply a hex: avoid hitting them (be careful with area spells).
When the five adventurers die, the final boss appears: the {creature:Fatal Bug}. Kill it: it is the one with the loot.
Step into the {item:Magic Forcefield (Green)|green teleport} to the **south** of the room and use the {item:Charred Skull}, with the {item:Jade Dragon Head} on you.
The green teleport does not let you escape before the boss dies, even if you have done this fight before.
Report with the Jade Dragon Head

Use the {item:Jade Dragon Head}. You get: *"S'Zallar: That was only the first step. Now find the hidden hoard beneath the Plains of Havoc. Attune to the prize possession there while while having the jade talisman with you."* The next lair is beneath the Plains of Havoc.

The wiki does not describe the exit from the relic room. Go back the way you came in: go up the 2 floors to the lair entrance and walk **south** to Thais. If you cannot find a way out, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}.
4. Second lair: Eldritch Dragon Lord (Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair)

The second lair is the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair|Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair}, beneath the Plains of Havoc. To get there you do the entrance of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest|The Pits of Inferno Quest}: you need a {item:Shovel}, a {item:Pick}, {item:Blood}, {item:Oil} and {item:The Holy Tible}. Cooldown: 20 hours.
Go to the Plains of Havoc
Go to **Venore** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain in Ab'Dendriel or Thais) and leave the city to the **south-west** towards the {wiki:Plains of Havoc|Plains of Havoc}.
Get The Holy Tible (if you do not have it yet)

On the small mountain very close to {wiki:Knightwatch Tower|Knightwatch Tower}, south of the Plains of Havoc temple, there is a chest with {item:The Holy Tible}. To climb the mountain you need {spell:Levitate} or 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels}; come down the same way.
Pits of Inferno Quest items: for this quest you only need the Holy Tible (next to Knightwatch Tower)

Go to the Plains of Havoc graveyard, next to the {wiki:Necromant House|Necromant House}, and use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} (there are several and they all lead to the same narrow cave).
Opening the hole with the Pick
In the **east** part of the cave there is a 3x4 room. Use the {item:Pick} on the **north-west corner** of that room and go down the hole that opens.
North-west corner: use the Pick here
{wiki:Goshnar|Goshnar}'s grave is just **west** of where you land. Stand **1 sqm south** of the gravestone and use the {item:Blood} on it: all players on that tile are taken to the catacombs.
Entrance: blood on Goshnar's gravestone, Shrine of Wonders with the Holy Tible, hole to the Pits of Inferno, bridge with oil and a stone to break with the Pick
Bring several vials of blood. In Optional PvP the team can stack on the same tile and get through with a single vial; in Open PvP without dove and in Hardcore PvP each player needs their own.
Get through the Shrine of Wonders

Go **north** (to the south there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, which you do not need). Before the magic wall there is a tile with inscriptions: step on it with {item:The Holy Tible} in your backpack and you pass to the other side.
Go down to the Pits of Inferno
To the **east** there is a sign *"To the Pits of Inferno"* (there is a level 30 expertise door). Go down that hole and head **south** to a bridge.
If there are fields on top of the hole, use a {item:Destroy Field Rune}.
If the bridge is intact, cross it. If it is broken, use the {item:Oil} on the lever **south of the bridge, on the west side**, pull it and cross.
If the bridge collapses with you on the other side, the only way back is through the dragon lair. You can throw oil to the other side if the team needs it.
Cool the lava and go down to the lair

Next there is a lava river or a floor of already cooled lava. If there is lava, use the {item:Pick} on the stone beside it to cool it. Cross to the **3 holes**: they all lead to the Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair.

You go down into the dragon lair, full of {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Dragon|Dragons}. The {creature:Eldritch Dragon Lord}'s room is **north-west** of the centre of the lair, at this spot.
Mechanic: Pulsating Lavas and Flame Totems

There are 4 {creature:Pulsating Lava|Pulsating Lavas}, one in each corner of the room. When they regain enough health they turn into {creature:Eruption} and then into {creature:Flame Totem}. Each totem deals area fire damage that **heals the boss**, with a larger range at each stage. With a Flame Totem active the boss takes less damage; with **3 or more** it becomes **invulnerable**. The goal is to keep **at least 2** in the Pulsating Lava state so the boss stays vulnerable.

Do not use **fire** damage; attack with **ice** and wear protection against **fire**. As the boss's health drops, there are moments when the Pulsating Lavas regain health and turn back into Flame Totems: stay alert.
After you kill the boss, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield (Green)|green teleport} to the **south-west** of the room and use the {item:Molten Throne}, with the {item:Jade Dragon Head} on you.
The green teleport does not let you escape before the boss dies.
Report with the Jade Dragon Head

Use the {item:Jade Dragon Head}. You get: *"S'Zallar: Well done. Now seek the hoard in the deadly ice caves around the island of Okolnir. Attune to the prize possession there while while having the jade talisman with you."*

The wiki does not describe the exit from the relic room or from the lair. Go back the same way: climb up from the dragon lair, cross the bridge and return through the catacombs and the graveyard cave to the Plains of Havoc. Venore is to the **north-east**. If the bridge has collapsed, the Pits of Inferno Quest spoiler only says that the only way back is through the dragon lair (without describing it); in that case use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}.

The third lair is in the icy caves of {wiki:Okolnir|Okolnir}, an island south-east of Hrodmir. Some pirate rat-men have a ship with cannons that fire at anything that moves, and you will use that to your advantage. Cooldown: 20 hours.

Take a boat to **Svargrond** from Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); from Ab'Dendriel, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you to any of those cities. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat.
{npc:Buddel} is **south** of Svargrond. Say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:okolnir}: the trip costs **50 gp**. He only takes you if you have done the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}.

Buddel is always drunk and often takes you to the wrong place. With a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack he takes you to the right place, but keeps the ring (and you do not pay the 50 gp). Since you will need the ring for The Gravedigger, if you do not want to lose it say {key:no} when he asks for it, or wear it on your finger (with more than one ring in your backpack, only {key:no} stops him from keeping one).

From the Okolnir pier, walk **south-west** to the Ice Horror's icy caves, at this spot. On the island there are {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} and {creature:Frost Dragon Hatchling|Frost Dragon Hatchlings}.

The NPC **Drunken Sailor** explains the mechanic (the wiki does not say where he is; the conversation is in the Ice Horror section): say {key:hi}, {key:listen up}, {key:ice}, {key:drunks}, {key:die} and {key:hoard}. In short: the rat-men have cannons on the ship and fire at anything that moves, and the ice leaves you staggering as if you were drunk.

Wear protection against **ice** and **death**. Bring {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb Runes}: the wiki recommends them for dealing with {wiki:Fear|Fear}. During the fight each player is {wiki:Drunk|Drunk} (it cannot be removed) and is often {wiki:Rooted|Rooted} and Feared.

In the boss room, the ship on the **right** fires at random players: a red target appears on the ground along with the message *"You are targeted!"*. About **3 seconds** later there is a small explosion that hurts all creatures around it and leaves a **hole in the ice** for a while.
If you step into a hole in the ice, you are frozen and {wiki:Rooted|Rooted}.
Clear a path through the Ice Blockades

To the **north** there are two {creature:Ice Blockade|Ice Blockades}. When you are the target, stand next to one of them: the explosion destroys it and opens the way. Repeat at the second one. Along the way {creature:Ice Crawler|Ice Crawlers} appear: do not waste time killing them, the cannons take care of them.
Hurt the Ice Horror with the cannons

At first the {creature:Ice Horror} is almost invulnerable: the team has to damage it with the cannon explosions. At around **half health**, its shell breaks (*"The ice carpace breaks and the Ice Horror becomes vullnerable to ordinary attacks!"*), a large wave (about **20**) of Ice Crawlers appears and the boss starts taking normal damage. Kill it.

Step into the {item:Magic Forcefield (Green)|green teleport} to the **north** of the room. **Stand still** until the Drunk wears off and only then use the {item:Draconic Rattle}, with the {item:Jade Dragon Head} on you.
If you move while still drunk you may accidentally leave the room before using the relic. The green teleport also won't let you escape before the boss dies.
Report with the Jade Dragon Head

Use the {item:Jade Dragon Head}. You receive: *"S'Zallar: Again you were successful. The last hoard is located in the Mountain that seperates destert and jungle in Darama. Attune to the prize possession there while while having the jade talsiman with you."* It is the {wiki:Kha'zeel|Kha'zeel} mountain.

The wiki doesn't describe the way out of the relic room: go back the way you came in to the Okolnir dock. Say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:svargrond} to {npc:Buddel}; in Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin, Thais or Venore.

The last lair is in {wiki:Kha'zeel|Kha'zeel}, the mountain range that separates the Ankrahmun desert from the Tiquanda jungle: it is the middle dragon lair, north of Ankrahmun. The {item:Dwarven Ring} is mandatory. Cooldown: 20 hours.

Take a boat to **Ankrahmun** from Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); from Ab'Dendriel, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you to Edron or Venore. You arrive at {npc:Captain Sinbeard}'s boat.
Go to the middle dragon lair
Leave Ankrahmun and walk **north** through the desert to the entrance of the middle dragon lair of {wiki:Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs/Kha'labal|Kha'zeel} (the *Ank 3x spawn*).
On the lair floors there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}.
Go up to the lever room
Cross the lair and go up to the indicated floor (**3 floors above** the entrance): that is where the entrance to the boss lever room is.

Put on the {item:Dwarven Ring}. Don't use **death** damage; attack with **earth**; equip protection against **death** and **energy**. {spell:Challenge} **doesn't work** on {creature:The Gravedigger}: he usually attacks the nearest player. Inside the room every player's speed drops a lot.

Every **10 seconds** 2 {creature:Bonelord Totem|Bonelord Totems} appear in random positions, replacing the previous ones. They make anyone nearby (small area) {wiki:Drunk|Drunk} and anyone standing right next to them {wiki:Rooted|Rooted}: keep your distance.

Every **30 seconds** a wave crosses the room, from **north to south** or from **west to east**. Each wave is 2 sqm wide, moves 1 sqm per second and comes in pairs, separated by 5 free sqm. Each time a wave passes through you, you gain a stack, which increases the damage you take. The boss also gains stacks if the wave passes through him (more damage dealt and less damage taken), so try to keep the waves from crossing him.
The **21st stack kills you instantly**. Use the gaps in the waves (next table) so you don't cross them.

According to the wiki's diagrams, each wall of a wave has a gap where you can stand without being hit. Gap positions (counted from the west on north→south waves, which are 18 sqm wide, and from the north on west→east waves, which are 20 sqm tall):
North wall: sqm 10 to 12 (slightly east of the middle)
After killing the boss, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield (Green)|green teleport} to the **south-east** of the room and use the {item:Gilded Wig}, with the {item:Jade Dragon Head} on you.
The green teleport does not let you escape before the boss dies.
Report with the Jade Dragon Head

Use the {item:Jade Dragon Head}. You receive: *"S'Zallar: You have attuned to all four ancients. Return to me in Ab'Dendriel and use my canoe to travel to the dragon cemetery again and confront the necromancer who is responsible for this atrocity."*

The wiki doesn't describe the way out of the relic room. Go back the way you came up: go down the 3 floors, leave through the lair entrance and walk **south** to Ankrahmun. {npc:Captain Sinbeard} doesn't go to Ab'Dendriel: take a boat to Venore or Edron and from there another one to Ab'Dendriel.
With the four ancients attuned, S'Zallar takes you by canoe to Draconia to face the necromancer in the {wiki:Forgotten Crypt|Forgotten Crypt}. Cooldown: 20 hours; the fight has a **15-minute** limit.
Return to Ab'Dendriel and talk to {npc:S'Zallar M'Andar}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:passage} and {key:yes}. His canoe, prepared with ancient magic, crosses the mists that protect the island.

The canoe takes you back to Draconia (S'Zallar talks about returning to the dragon cemetery). The {creature:Bone Overlord}'s room is in the {wiki:Forgotten Crypt|Forgotten Crypt}, beneath Draconia: the {npc:Dragon Ancestor Spirit} had already warned that the necromancer is *"Deep beneath us"*. The wiki doesn't describe the route between the spot where the canoe drops you off and the room: use the coordinate as your guide.
In the Forgotten Crypt there are {creature:Crypt Construct|Crypt Constructs}, {creature:Haunted Hunter|Haunted Hunters} and {creature:Walking Dread|Walking Dreads} (23,000 to 25,000 HP each).

Bring {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb Runes} (suggested by the wiki). In phase 1 equip protection against **death** and **energy**; in phase 2 against **Life Drain** and **death**. Throughout the fight you can become {wiki:Feared|Feared}, {wiki:Rooted|Rooted}, {wiki:Slowed|Slowed} or {wiki:Drunk|Drunk} at any moment: be ready for all four.
You have **15 minutes** to finish the fight.
Throughout the fight the boss picks a player (who sees *"The bonelord gazes!"*) and casts one of these effects:

You are teleported to another room: break the {creature:Bone Barrier|Bone Barriers} (10,000 HP each) to open the way to the teleport that takes you back to the main room. The barriers respawn: if you stand on the spot where they respawn, they appear next to it and may no longer block the way.

{creature:An Eye} appears near you. After a few seconds it explodes in an area and deals **20 to 30% of max HP** to each player as agony damage. There can be several at the same time: move away from them.
Wraithfire under your feet: **15% of current HP** as agony damage.
Mana drain: you lose **5% of max mana every 2 seconds**, 5 times.
Curse: you explode in a small radius with physical damage every 4 seconds, 4 times. The explosion also hurts the other players: move away from the team.

In the room there are four Soulcages, each linked to a dragon spirit (such as {creature:Myzareth's Spirit}) and to a condition that is randomly applied to all players. The spirits are **immune to damage**; the Soulcages can be destroyed (the wiki says their health is shared). Use the right element on each one:

Never let a spirit get close to its Soulcage: it heals **5000+ per turn**. When a Soulcage's health drops to certain points, the spirit teleports next to it (last column), which makes the healing harder to prevent.

Once the four Soulcages are destroyed, the {creature:Bonelords's Phylactery} and 4 {creature:Enthralled Dragon|Enthralled Dragons} appear in the **south** of the room. Destroy the Phylactery to win: the Bone Overlord is not a real creature and the loot comes from the Phylactery.
The Enthralled Dragons **are not affected by {spell:Challenge}** and it is vital to have **Life Drain** protection against them.

The wiki doesn't describe the way out of the boss room or a return by canoe. Use the Draconia exits from section 2 (Dragonfetish, the walking route through the Hellgate with a {item:Rope} and 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} or {spell:Levitate}, or the {wiki:Draconia Quest} portal) or a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}, and go back to S'Zallar in Ab'Dendriel.

Talk to {npc:S'Zallar M'Andar}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:reward} and {key:yes}. He gives you one of the necromantic runes he found, a random {item:Crypt Rune}, and says the talisman will give you a small share of the ancients' power every two weeks.

Use the {item:Jade Dragon Head}: it turns into a {item:Jade Dragon Head (Charged)}. You can use it **every 14 days**: each use gives 1 {wiki:Ancestral Charge|Ancestral Charge} and 1 {wiki:Favour of the Ancients|Favour of the Ancients} (*"You have gained Ancestral Charges and Favour of the Ancients!"*) and the talisman becomes an {item:Inert Dragon Head} while it recharges. If it is still too early you see *"It is too early to use this again!"*.
You can see your charges in the Quest Log, under *The Spirits Are At Ease*.

The quest opens three hunting areas near Ab'Dendriel. The Forgotten Crypt is the outer crypt, beneath Draconia, where the Bone Overlord is; the wiki doesn't say where the entrances to the Forsaken Crypt and the Unhallowed Crypt are.
Path to the Bone Overlord. {creature:Crypt Construct|Crypt Constructs} drop {item:Fetid Heart|Fetid Hearts} (each one gives 5 Ancestral Charges).

Designed for solo hunting: {creature:Cyclursus} applies a skill debuff if more than one player is nearby. {creature:Crypt Mage|Crypt Mages} drop {item:Cryptic Fossil|Cryptic Fossils} (1 Favour of the Ancients each).
1 Favour of the Ancients per entry
{creature:Creepy Crawler} can cause Fear for 2 seconds.
Trade Crypt Runes for a Crypt weapon

After finishing the quest, each boss can drop a Crypt Rune. Collect **one of each** and hand them to the {npc:Dragon Ancestor Spirit}, in the Draconia cemetery: {key:hi}, {key:trade}, {key:yes}. You receive a random weapon from {item:Crypt Bile}, {item:Crypt Breaker}, {item:Crypt Jaw}, {item:Crypt Slicer}, {item:Crypt Spine}, {item:Crypt Splitter} and {item:Crypt Strike}.
All bosses have a **20-hour** cooldown. Each one can drop an item that, when used, is consumed and resets that boss's cooldown:
{item:Composite Hornbow}, {item:Traditional Sai}, {item:Mercenary Sword}, {item:Wand of Everblazing}, {item:Muck Rod}, plasma rings and necklace

The {creature:Adventurer Group} counts as a single boss in the Bosstiary and can be the boosted boss of the day. The {creature:Bone Overlord} can also be boosted, but the loot comes from the {creature:Bonelords's Phylactery}.
Crypt Runes only drop for players who have already finished the quest; according to the test server, they are affected by the Bosstiary boss slot bonus.
The wiki doesn't document where the green teleports lead after the relics, nor the way back from the Forgotten Crypt: follow the exit directions in each section.
If you lose the {item:Jade Dragon Head}, say {key:talisman} to {npc:S'Zallar M'Andar}.
